title: Other Health Insurance and TRICARE Prime Claims
content:
**TRICARE Prime** is secondary payer to other health insurance for tiers marked secondary in the table below. Medicaid and TRICARE supplements are not other health insurance.

## Clauses

1. Other health insurance is put on file or removed from the date the beneficiary reports it, and claim lines adjudicated earlier on the wrong basis are reversed and posted again.
2. Active duty service members are never treated as having other health insurance.
3. The other insurer's payment on a line is the payment shown on that insurer's explanation of benefits and is never estimated.

| Tier | TRICARE pays after other health insurance |
|---|---|
| TRICARE Prime Active Duty Service Member | no |
| TRICARE Prime Remote Active Duty Service Member | no |
| TRICARE Prime Active Duty Family Member | yes |
| TRICARE Prime Remote Active Duty Family Member | yes |
| TRICARE Prime Transitional Survivor | yes |
| TRICARE Prime Retiree Group A | yes |
| TRICARE Prime Retiree Group B | yes |

## Basis questions

**A retiree's only other coverage is a TRICARE supplement. Is TRICARE secondary?** No; a TRICARE supplement is not other health insurance.

**The other insurer's explanation of benefits has not arrived. Is its payment estimated?** No; the payment entered on a line is the one shown on the explanation of benefits.
